title: Modal: should
description: Practice Modal: should (extended with deeper practice).

questions.question: You ___ see a doctor if you feel very ill.
questions.explanation: Should is followed by the base verb.

questions.question: You ___ rest if you feel sick.
questions.explanation: Should is followed by the base verb.

questions.question: He ___ call a doctor if the pain continues.
questions.explanation: Should is followed by the base verb.

questions.question: We ___ leave early to avoid traffic.
questions.explanation: Should is followed by the base verb.

questions.question: She ___ take an umbrella today.
questions.explanation: Should is followed by the base verb.

questions.question: You ___ apologise — it wasn't your fault.
questions.explanation: 'Shouldn't' gives advice that something is not a good idea.

questions.question: ___ I tell her the truth?
questions.explanation: 'Should' is used to ask for advice.
